steps.title: West stack
steps.rule: Everyone stacks west of centre.

steps.title: East of the stack
steps.rule: Step east, out of the Weight puddles, as one group.

steps.title: Back west, inside the Eye
steps.rule: Back to the west stack, inside the Eye of the Storm's safe ring.
steps.cue: Eye of the Storm and Mesohigh tethers

steps.title: Clear of the first Mesohigh
steps.rule: Spread by group: tanks at the orb, healers west, melee and caster south-west, physical ranged south, so the tether has room.

MainTank.rule: Take the orb with the off tank.

OffTank.rule: Take the orb with the main tank.

steps.title: First Mesohigh taker east
steps.rule: The first tether taker runs east to stretch the Mesohigh.

steps.title: Searing Wind holder north
steps.rule: With Searing Wind, go to the north edge, slightly west, away from everyone.

steps.title: Other healer to the north edge
steps.rule: The healer without Searing Wind goes to the north edge.

steps.title: Ahead of Feather Rain
steps.rule: Move ahead of the feathers: party to the north edge, tanks east of centre, ranged to the north-east corner.

MainTank.rule: East of centre with the off tank.

OffTank.rule: East of centre with the main tank.

steps.title: Tanks out of the puddles
steps.rule: Tanks step out of the feather puddles.

steps.title: Group north, tanks on the orb
steps.rule: Party at the north edge; tanks on the orb; Searing Wind holder stays apart.

MainTank.rule: On the orb, east of centre.

OffTank.rule: On the orb, east of centre.

steps.title: Tanks to the north edge
steps.rule: Tanks join the north edge, main tank west of the off tank.

steps.title: First taker to the north edge
steps.rule: The first Mesohigh taker rejoins the north edge.

steps.title: Out of the lines
steps.rule: Party north-west, between the Landslide and the dash line; tanks on each side.

MainTank.rule: West side, out of both lines.

OffTank.rule: East side, out of both lines.

steps.title: Searing Wind holder south-east
steps.rule: With Searing Wind, go south-east, away from the party.

steps.title: North-west stack
steps.rule: Stack north-west; the off tank takes the orb; the Searing Wind holder stays apart.
steps.cue: Eye of the Storm and second Mesohigh

OffTank.rule: Take the orb east of centre.

steps.title: Main tank steps in
steps.rule: Main tank moves to the north-west, just off the stack.

steps.title: Ahead of the second Feather Rain
steps.rule: Move ahead of the feathers: party west of centre, main tank north, off tank east.

steps.title: Out of the puddles
steps.rule: Step out of the feather puddles, staying grouped.

steps.title: North-west stack again
steps.rule: Stack north-west; main tank north of centre, off tank east.

steps.title: Searing Wind holder rejoins
steps.rule: Rejoin the north-west stack once Searing Wind is gone.

steps.title: Out of the Radiant Plumes
steps.rule: Party to the north-west corner; main tank north; off tank north-east.

steps.title: West of the Diffractive Laser
steps.rule: Party west of the laser line; main tank north of centre; off tank east.
